The '''2014–15 Southern Utah Thunderbirds basketball team''' represented [[Southern Utah University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The [[Southern Utah Thunderbirds basketball|Thunderbirds]] were led by third year head coach [[Nick Robinson (basketball)|Nick Robinson]] and played their home games at the [[Centrum Arena (Utah)|Centrum Arena]]. They were members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. They finished the season 10–19, 7–11 in Big Sky play to finish in ninth place. They failed to qualify for the [[2015 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]].
